preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 20,000.
Number of vertices in each test case is between 2 and 200,000.
Number of edges in each test case is between 1 and the minimum of 200,000 and n*(n-1)/2.
Type of each edge is either 0 (undirected) or 1 (directed).
Vertices connected by each edge are between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if it is possible to direct the undirected edges to make the graph acyclic, otherwise 'NO'.
All edges in the output are directed.
